t: The $(item)Wire$() simply transmits the $(thing)input signal$() to the $(thing)output$(). Simple, straightforward, lag free. It can only go in straight lines though. $(br2)On the upside, as with all other blocks made using $(l:rftoolsbase:basics/machine_bases)Machine Bases$(), it can be placed on walls or ceilings.
$(item)连线$()仅用于将$(thing)输入信号$()传输至$(thing)输出$()。简单直接，且无延迟。但其仅能沿直线铺设。$(br2)优点在于，与所有使用$(l:rftoolsbase:basics/machine_bases)机器基座$()制作的方块一样，它可被放置在墙壁或天花板上。
